verdict.rationale: vLLM's Hugging Face integration and GGUF/quantization format support imply it uses standard HF cache/model file formats that other tools could also read, but there is no explicit documentation confirming that downloaded weights or caches are reusable across runtimes without re-download or re-conversion. missing for 10: explicit statement on shared HF cache directory reuse, explicit compatibility guarantees for GGUF/safetensors files across tools like llama.cpp/transformers, independent confirmation of cache interoperability.
